notes.title: Yung Venuz Plushie
notes.content:
Yung Venuz Plushie
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5197250/ffe15f3cf3c4dff29b9ab0e1e5416c91a15351f7.png"]

We just launched a Makeship Petition to summon your favorite dead body looting mutant shooting triangular gun god! Now 100% more huggable, including the cutest stack of cash you've ever seen.	 



Key stats:

The original Gun God. 	

Including a fat stack of cash, valued at approximately 1000000 Venusian mony. 	

Triangle (the best shape) 	

 Passive ability: Higher Rate of Fire.

As seen in Nuclear Throne and Gun Godz.

Yung Venuz is cool.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26886360/f9a69c01adbe1a4589acfc2176be0e121a9b4c36.png"]



We're gonna need at least 200 pledges to help bring this Y.V. plushie into existence, so please tell your friends and head over to the campaign!
